prep.html:
Before the first lesson

The first lesson is 12 September. Have this list ready by then — it takes about 30 minutes in all, and it means we start working straight away in class.

Download the PDF
01

A computer

A MacBook is recommended, Windows works too. A phone or a tablet is not enough.

  1. Bring your own laptop — the praktikum is hands-on from beginning to end.
  2. Bring the charger as well.
  3. Leave at least 5 GB free on the disk.
02

A Google account

Claude, NotebookLM and Gemini all open through this account. If you already have one, you do not need a new one.

  1. Open accounts.google.com/signup.
  2. Enter your first name, last name and a new email address.
  3. Confirm your phone number — a code arrives by SMS.
  4. Write the password down: you will need it in class.
Create a Google account
03

Claude

The main tool of the praktikum. Open an account on claude.ai first, then install the app.

  1. Go to claude.ai and sign up with "Continue with Google".
  2. Download the app from claude.ai/download.
  3. Mac: open the .dmg and drag the Claude icon into Applications.
  4. Windows: run the .exe and confirm the installation.
  5. Sign in to the app with that same Google account.
Download the Claude appOpen an account on claude.ai
04

A Visa card

You will need it for a Claude Pro subscription. The free tier is enough for the first lesson.

  1. Get an international Visa or Mastercard from your bank — Uzcard and Humo do not work here.
  2. The card needs a dollar account with online payments enabled.
  3. Pro costs $20 a month. It is not required, but it makes the work considerably easier.

You will need it in the later lessons.

lessons.title: Introduction
lessons.subtitle: What AI is, models, Context, RAG, NotebookLM
lessons.summary: We look at what AI actually is, how models work, and why context decides everything. Practice: NotebookLM.

materials.title: Sources
materials.note: Seven files — the documents of a fictional company. Load these into NotebookLM as sources, and nothing else.
materials.footnote: Do not rename the files — the prompts refer to them by name.

materials.title: Prompts
materials.note: The thirteen prompts of the exercise. Each has a copy button beside it — you paste it straight into NotebookLM.

materials.title: Student guide
materials.note: The written guide to the task: the order of the exercise and what to pay attention to.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.subtitle: NotebookLM exercise — Ravon Uy
prompts.lede: Copy each prompt and paste it into NotebookLM. Go in order: each one builds on the answer before it.
rules: Load only the 7 files in the Manbaalar folder into NotebookLM as sources.
Do not load these prompts as sources — they are questions, not sources.
Before each prompt, select only the sources it needs and clear the rest.
prompts.footnote: Every detail of the company is invented — written for the exercise. The exercise date is 12.09.2026.

items.title: An answer from one source
items.text: Use only the 03_Yetkazish_qoidalari source. What is the standard delivery time to Tashkent region for a product held in stock? Answer in one sentence, quoting the relevant clause.

items.title: Checking the price
items.text: Compare the K1 row in the 02_Amaldagi_narxlar.csv table with the price in 04_Reklama_qoralamasi. Table columns: the claim in the advert, the rule in force, a quote from both sources, the correction. Take into account the mahsulot_kodi, holat and amal_boshlanishi columns in the CSV, and the approval status of the advert.

items.title: The promise and the process
items.text: Compare the 03_Yetkazish_qoidalari and 04_Reklama_qoralamasi documents. Which conditions does the promise "all orders in 24 hours" fail to meet? Quote from both sources. Separate a real contradiction from a permitted exception.

items.title: Checking the exception
items.text: Select the 03_Yetkazish_qoidalari and 06_Buyurtmalar sources. Order RU-001 was delivered in 18 hours. Does that contradict the standard time, or is it a permitted express service? Check the region, stock availability, the time of confirmation and the director’s approval. Say so if evidence is missing.

items.title: The missing information
items.text: Relying only on the 07_Yigilish_qaydi source, work out how much an extra courier charges for one delivery. If the information is not there, do not guess the amount. Write down who to ask and which document to request.

items.title: Testing the decision
items.text: In the exercise, today is 12.09.2026. Assess the proposal to launch a "we deliver every order in 24 hours" campaign on 14 September. Table: supporting evidence, opposing evidence, what is unknown, the source. Without evidence, invent neither an objection nor praise. Finish by making the case for one option: leave it as it is, change the terms, or wait.

items.title: One page for the director
items.text: Prepare a decision brief of up to 300 words for the director of Ravon Uy. Structure: the decision to be made; the recommendation; 3 findings with their sources; the open question; next actions with an owner, a deadline and a test of success. Keep fact, proposal and assumption apart. Use only the original documents selected.

items.title: An FAQ for the customer
items.text: Use only the 02_Amaldagi_narxlar.csv table and the 03_Yetkazish_qoidalari document. Write 5 short questions and answers for customers: the K1 price, the city delivery time, the regional delivery time, all the conditions of the 24-hour service, and the delivery charge. Add a source quote to each answer so it can be checked. Do not name internal staff in the copy meant for the customer.

groups.title: Extra
groups.note: If there is time left, or to work on at home.

items.title: The hidden assumption
items.text: Test the assumption of 30 orders a day in 07_Yigilish_qaydi. Which evidence is there, and which is missing? What follows if the assumption is wrong? Propose a way to check it. Do not write unfounded probabilities or percentages.

items.title: Timing and authority
items.text: From 02_Amaldagi_narxlar.csv, 04_Reklama_qoralamasi and 05_Eski_narxlar.csv, build the history of the K1 price. Show the date written, the period it applied, the approval status, and the document that superseded it. Do not pick today’s price by the date of the newest file.

items.title: Through the customer’s eyes
items.text: Using 04_Reklama_qoralamasi and 03_Yetkazish_qoidalari, find the sentences a customer could misread. For each, give a quote and propose clearer wording. Do not impute an unproven intent to mislead.

items.title: The reason they disagree
items.text: Using 04_Reklama_qoralamasi and 07_Yigilish_qaydi, analyse why the marketing and operations views differ. Separate evidence, period, purpose and assumption. Mark each reason with a source or with "unconfirmed".

items.title: Balanced criticism
items.text: Check the conclusion below against the sources: supporting evidence, opposing evidence, the uncertainty, and what would prompt a review. Object to the conclusion only where there is evidence. Do not invent evidence the sources do not contain.

praktikum.title: Korxona bilimini ishga soling.
praktikum.lead: Practical results for HR, sales, service, the warehouse and marketing.
rules: Open a separate notebook for each exercise.
Load only that exercise’s Manbaalar files.
Open the brief first — it says what the exercise consists of.

exercises.title: Something for a new hire to lean on
exercises.note: A first-week plan, flashcards, and a test that checks what stuck.

prompts.title: The first-week plan
prompts.text: Sovuq Zanjir Servisga yangi savdo menejeri keldi. Tanlangan manbalar asosida uni dastlabki 5 ish kunida ishga oʻrgatish rejasini tuzing. Jadvalda har kunning mavzusi, amaliy vazifasi, masʼuli va xodim oʻrganganini qanday koʻrsatishini yozing. Har vazifaning manbasi va sahifasini koʻrsating. Birinchi kun, Bitrix24 va 1C, mahsulotlar, savdo, servis va hujjatlar bilan tanishuvni qamrang. Siz qoʻshgan tekshirish usullarini "oʻquv taklifi" deb belgilang. Hujjatda koʻrsatilmagan vakolat, muddat yoki natija talabini oʻzingizdan qoʻshmang. Qoʻllanma bilan rasmiy qoida zid boʻlsa, qatʼiy xulosa bermay xodimlar bilan ishlash boʻlimi aniqlashtirishi kerakligini yozing. Javob oʻzbek lotin yozuvida boʻlsin.

prompts.title: Flashcards
prompts.text: Yangi savdo menejeri uchun qisqa kartalar yarating. Mavzular: birinchi kun; birinchi hafta; kimga murojaat qilish; Bitrix24 va 1C vazifasi; parollarni saqlash; mijozga vaʼda berishdan oldin manbani tekshirish. Har kartada bitta savol va qisqa javob boʻlsin. Faqat aniq, manbada tasdiqlangan faktlar. Taʼtil, mehnat huquqi yoki hujjatlar oʻrtasida ziddiyatli qoida haqida karta tuzmang. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

prompts.title: A situational test
prompts.text: Yangi savdo menejeri uchun vaziyatli test yarating. "Mahsulot kodini qayerdan topaman?", "Servis boʻyicha kimga murojaat qilaman?", "Parolni hamkasbga bersam boʻladimi?", "Mijozga muddat aytishdan oldin nima qilaman?" kabi ish vaziyatlarini qamrang. Har savolda bitta asosli javob boʻlsin. Javob izohi manbaga tayanishi kerak. Taʼtil va hujjatlar oʻrtasidagi ziddiyatlarni testga kiritmang. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

prompts.title: Text instead of the studio
prompts.text: Tanlangan manbalardan yangi savdo menejeri uchun 5 ta savol-javob kartasi va 5 ta vaziyatli test tuzing. Testda 3 tadan variant boʻlsin. Toʻgʻri javoblar va manba izohlarini eng oxirida alohida "Oʻqituvchi tekshiradi" boʻlimiga joylang. Taʼtil va ziddiyatli qoidalarni ishlatmang. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

exercises.title: From the product to the conversation
exercises.note: A short pitch a customer can follow, and three questions that surface their needs.

prompts.title: Evidence for the pitch
prompts.text: Kafe egasi uchun qisqa savdo taqdimotiga tayyorlanyapman. Bon Appetit keysining oʻzini va 01.06.2026 narxlar roʻyxatini ishlating. 1) Mijoz muammosi, yechim va natijani manbasi bilan ajrating. 2) SZ-650 va KP-6 uchun kod, nom, QQS bilan narx, narx sanasi va montaj shartini jadvalda bering. 3) Yangi mijozdan soʻraladigan 3 ta ehtiyoj savolini taklif qiling. Keysdagi natijani yangi mijozga vaʼda qilmang. Manbada yoʻq texnik afzallik, chegirma, ombor qoldigʻi yoki yetkazish muddatini oʻylab topmang. Fakt va savdo taklifini ajrating. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

prompts.title: A short sales pitch
prompts.text: Kafe egasi uchun taxminan 5 slaydlik qisqa savdo taqdimoti yarating. 1: kafe oshxonalaridagi turli uskunalar muammosi. 2: Bon Appetitda yagona oshxona standarti qanday joriy qilingan. 3: faqat shu keys natijasi - taom tayyorlash 18 daqiqadan 12 daqiqaga; haftasiga taxminan 10 soat tejalishi bosh oshpaz bahosi ekanini yozing. 4: 01.06.2026 roʻyxatidan SZ-650 va KP-6 narxlari, QQS bilan, montaj alohida; bu tayyor loyiha smetasi emas. 5: yangi mijozga 3 ta ehtiyoj savoli va joyni koʻrib chiqishni kelishish taklifi. Har slaydda bitta asosiy fikr. Kam matn, sodda chiziqli ikonka, qora fon, och matn. Yangi mijozga shu natijani kafolatlamang. Har muhim fakt yonida manba nomi/sahifasi yoki mahsulot kodini koʻrsating. "Oʻquv qoralamasi" belgisi boʻlsin. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

exercises.title: What does the operator do?
exercises.note: A guide for the operator on taking a request, and answers to the common questions.

prompts.title: Taking the request
prompts.text: Oʻquv vaziyati: Samarqanddagi mijoz SZ-400 ekranida E07 chiqqanini aytdi. Men servis operatoriman, texnik emasman. Tanlangan manbalardan operator soʻrashi kerak boʻlgan maʼlumotlar, qayd qilish joyi, servisga topshirish va mijozga aytiladigan muddatni toping. Muddat qachondan hisoblanishini aniq yozing. Toʻlov/kafolat holati nomaʼlum boʻlsa, uni tekshiriladigan savol sifatida qoldiring. Har qoidaga manba va sahifa/band bering. Texnik qoʻllanmada mutaxassis uchun yozilgan taʼmirlashni mijozga tavsiya qilmang. Sovutish gazi (R290) bilan ishlash yoki elektr qismlarini ochish va tuzatish boʻyicha yoʻl-yoʻriq bermang. Operator javobini oʻzbek lotin yozuvida tuzing.

prompts.title: The operator’s guide
prompts.text: SZSning yangi servis operatori uchun bir sahifalik ish yoʻriqnomasi tayyorlang. Boʻlimlar: 1) mijozdan olinadigan maʼlumotlar; 2) murojaatni qayd qilish; 3) servisga topshirish; 4) mijozga muddatni tushuntirish; 5) javobi manbada yoʻq boʻlsa nima qilish. Oxirida muddat, diagnostika, ehtiyot qism va kafolat boʻyicha 4 ta savol va ularga qisqa javob boʻlsin. Barcha javoblar tanlangan manbalarga tayansin, manba/sahifa koʻrsatilsin. Kafolatdan keyingi diagnostika bilan barcha taʼmirni bir narx deb aytmang. Bu operator materiali: sovutgichning elektr yoki sovutish tizimini ochish va taʼmirlash boʻyicha koʻrsatma bermang. Manbada yoʻq vaʼda qoʻshmang. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

exercises.title: Follow the order through
exercises.note: A map of the topics through Mind Map, and a checklist before anything is sent.

prompts.title: From whom to whom?
prompts.text: Faqat Reglament.pdf asosida oddiy buyurtmaning savdodan ombor, logistika va qabul qilishgacha boʻlgan yoʻlini tushuntiring. Jadvalda har bosqichni, masʼulini, ish boshlash uchun kerakli maʼlumotni va keyingi boʻlimga nima topshirilishini koʻrsating. Har bosqichning manba bandini yozing. 1Cda hozir sotish mumkin boʻlgan tovar bilan boshqa buyurtma uchun band qilingan tovarni farqlang. Imzolangan shartnomadagi maxsus shartlar boʻyicha istisnoni alohida yozing. Hujjatda masʼul koʻrsatilmagan boʻlsa "aniqlashtirish kerak" deb yozing. Toʻlov kuni hisoblanishi boʻyicha bandlar farqlansa, aniq sana chiqarmang, aniqlashtirish uchun ajrating. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

prompts.title: The pre-send checklist
prompts.text: Reglament.pdf asosida savdo va ombor xodimi uchun ixcham cheklist tuzing. Kamida quyidagilarni tekshirsin: mahsulot kodi, soni, manzil, aloqa shaxsi va telefon, montaj zarurati, toʻlov sharti/tasdigʻi, 1Cda sotish mumkin boʻlgan va boshqa buyurtmaga band qilingan tovarlar, mijozga kelishilgan yetkazish sharti. Jadvalda nima tekshirilishi, masʼul, tekshiriladigan hujjat va manba bandini yozing. Har qatorga bajarilganini belgilash uchun joy qoldiring. Manbada mavjud boʻlmagan yangi nazoratni qoʻshsangiz "taklif" deb belgilang. Kamchilik boʻlsa kimga aniqlashtirish yuborilishini koʻrsating; manbada belgilanmagan buyruq yoki taqiq yaratmang. Bu oʻquv andozasi, haqiqiy buyurtma yoki tizimdagi vazifa emas. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

exercises.title: One case, several formats
exercises.note: One infographic from the customer case; a look at what video or audio could add.

prompts.title: A fact card for the content
prompts.text: Faqat Mijoz keyslari hujjatining Bon Appetit boʻlimidan foydalaning. Kontentga kerakli maʼlumotlarni qisqa yozing: muammo nima edi, nima oʻzgardi, nechta kafe qatnashdi va natija qanday boʻldi? Oʻlchangan natija bilan taxminiy bahoni ajrating, bahoni kim berganini va manba sahifasini koʻrsating. Boshqa mijozlarning raqamlarini qoʻshmang. Hujjatda koʻrsatilmagan daromad, foyda yoki foizni oʻzingizdan hisoblab qoʻshmang. Oxirida mijozga vaʼda qilib boʻlmaydigan bitta umumlashtirishni koʻrsating. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

prompts.title: Infographic
prompts.text: Bon Appetit keysidan kafe biznesi egalari uchun bitta vertikal infografika yarating. Tuzilishi: MUAMMO → YECHIM → NATIJA. 6 kafeda turli uskunalardan yagona oshxona standartiga oʻtish koʻrinsin. Asosiy koʻrsatkich: tushlikda taom tayyorlash 18 daqiqadan 12 daqiqaga tushgan. Qoʻshimcha izoh: haftasiga taxminan 10 soat tejalishi bosh oshpaz hisobiga asoslangan. Bu faqat shu keys natijasi, boshqa mijozga kafolat emas. Boshqa keys raqamlari va yangi statistika qoʻshilmang. Qora fon, och matn, ingichka chiziqli ikonka, kam matn, yirik raqamlar. "Oʻquv namunasi" va "Manba: Mijoz keyslari, 3-sahifa" koʻrinsin. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

prompts.title: A short video
prompts.text: Faqat Bon Appetit haqidagi manba asosida kafe egalari uchun rus tilida qisqa video yarating. Turli oshxona uskunalari qanday muammo tugʻdirganini, 6 kafeda yagona tartib joriy qilinganini va taom tayyorlash vaqti 18 daqiqadan 12 daqiqaga tushganini tushuntiring. Haftasiga taxminan 10 soat tejalishi bosh oshpaz bahosi ekanini ayting. Boshqa mijozlarning natijalarini qoʻshmang va yangi mijozga shu natijani vaʼda qilmang. Sodda chiziqli rasmlardan foydalaning. Bu oʻquv uchun tuzilgan misol ekanini belgilang. Oxirida kafe egasiga "Oshxonangizda avval qaysi ishga ketayotgan vaqtni oʻlchaysiz?" degan savolni bering.

prompts.title: A video script in Uzbek
prompts.text: Faqat Bon Appetit keysi asosida kafe biznesi egasi uchun 60-90 soniyalik oʻzbekcha video ssenariysi yozing. Har kadrda nima koʻrinishi, ekranga qanday qisqa matn yozilishi va ovozda nima aytilishini jadvalda koʻrsating. Tuzilishi: muammo, 6 kafeda yagona oshxona standarti, natija, yakuniy savol. Taom tayyorlash 18 daqiqadan 12 daqiqaga tushgani va haftasiga taxminan 10 soat tejalishi bosh oshpaz bahosi ekanini aniq ajrating. Boshqa keys raqamlarini qoʻshmang, yangi mijozga aynan shu foydani kafolatlamang. Oʻquv namunasi deb belgilang. Oxirida tekshirish uchun manba sahifasini yozing. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida, ovoz chiqarib oʻqishga tabiiy gaplar bilan yozing.

exercises.title: The proposals into one table
exercises.note: A short checklist for the purchasing team, and questions for the supplier.

prompts.title: The purchasing checklist
prompts.text: Korxonamiz uchun bitta ish telefoni tanlayapmiz. Berilgan katalogdan yangi, sotuvda mavjud va kamida 12 oy kafolati bor telefonlarni toping. Narxi 7 million soʻmdan oshmasin. Mos takliflarni eng arzonidan boshlab jadvalda koʻrsating. Jadvalga taklif raqami, brendi, telefon nomi va modeli, xotira hajmi, holati, kafolat muddati, soʻmdagi narxi, qaysi doʻkonda sotilishi, shahar, eʼlon sanasi va yetkazish shartini kiriting. Bir telefon turli sotuvchilarda boʻlsa, har bir taklifni alohida qatorda qoldiring. Faqat talablarimizga mos telefonlarni kiriting. Maʼlumot yetishmasa, "berilmagan" deb yozing. Jadval sarlavhalari va izohlarini oʻzbekcha yozing. Bu katalog oʻquv uchun tuzilganini, narxlar haqiqiy savdo taklifi emasligini qayd eting.

prompts.title: Questions for the supplier
prompts.text: Telefonni xarid qilishdan oldin sotuvchidan aniqlashtirishimiz kerak boʻlgan 5 savolni yozing. Savollar telefon modeli va xotirasi, yakuniy narx va xarid hujjati, kafolat shartlari, sotuvda borligi hamda yetkazish haqida boʻlsin. Katalogda javobi bor savolni va javobi yetishmayotgan savolni ajrating. "Sotuvda bor" belgisi nechta telefon qolganini bildirmasligini hisobga oling. Bu oʻquv katalogi, undagi maʼlumotni haqiqiy sotuvchi tasdigʻi deb olmang. Faqat savollar matnini oʻzbekcha tayyorlang, hech kimga yubormang.

exercises.title: So the director follows it on the move
exercises.note: A short audio summary on one topic, and the questions the director will want answered.

prompts.title: A written summary for the director
prompts.text: Samarqand filiali kengayish rejasi asosida rahbar uchun 150 soʻzgacha qisqa xulosa yozing. Rejaning maqsadini, hozirgi holatni, rejalashtirilgan ishlarni va ochiq qolgan masalalarni tushuntiring. Oxirida uchrashuvda aniqlashtirish kerak boʻlgan 3 savolni yozing. Kelajak rejasini bajarilgan ish deb yozmang. Har asosiy daʼvoga manba sahifasi/bandi bering. Oʻzbek lotin yozuvida yozing.

prompts.target: Studio → Audio Overview → Brief / ruscha audio
prompts.title: A short audio summary
prompts.text: Samarqand filiali kengayish rejasi asosida korxona rahbari uchun rus tilida qisqa audio xulosa yarating. Rejaning maqsadi, hujjatda tasdiqlangan holat, hali rejalashtirilayotgan ishlar va qaror oldidan ochiq qolgan savollarni tushuntiring. Kelajakdagi taxminlarni erishilgan natija deb aytmang. Hujjatda koʻrsatilmagan tasdiqni oʻzingizdan qoʻshmang. Oxirida rahbar uchrashuvda berishi kerak boʻlgan 3 savolni ayting. Bu oʻquv uchun tuzilgan misol ekanini belgilang.

lessons.subtitle: Claude, Code / Cowork, terminology
lessons.summary: Working with Claude, and the terminology. Practice: a website, a lead form, a Telegram bot and a Sheets connection.
lessons.homework: Free work: using what you learned in the lesson, make something for your own business. What you make is up to you — what matters is that your business really needs it.

praktikum.title: 47 prompts — for your own business.
praktikum.lead: 47 ready prompts for ideas, critical thinking, sales, advertising and learning.
rules: Pick the prompt that fits your task.
Replace the parts in [brackets] with your own details.
Copy the whole text into Claude — inside your HQ Project, if your business lives there.
Check the answer against the facts and numbers of your own business.
praktikum.exercisesNote: Open the section that fits your task.
praktikum.promptsNote: Each stands alone — take the one you need.

exercises.title: Business ideas
exercises.note: Finding new business opportunities in recurring pains, your own edge and shifts in the market.

prompts.title: A business from recurring pains
prompts.text:
List 20 recurring operational pains in [industry] that businesses currently solve with manual labor, spreadsheets, or Telegram chats.
For each, estimate: monthly cost of the pain, willingness to pay, and why no one has automated it yet.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A business built on your edge
prompts.text:
I have access to [asset: audience / data / distribution channel / skill].
Generate 15 business ideas that are only possible because of this asset - ideas where a competitor without it cannot follow.
Exclude ideas anyone could start.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Interview me
prompts.text:
Interview me.
Ask 10 questions, one at a time, about my daily work frustrations.
After the interview, propose 5 business ideas where each idea solves a frustration shared by at least 10,000 other people like me.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: An idea you can test in 14 days
prompts.text:
Generate 10 business ideas I can validate in 14 days with under $500, using only [my skills] and a Telegram channel as distribution.
Each idea must have a paying customer as the validation milestone, not signups.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A business for a small team
prompts.text:
Give me 10 businesses that can reach $10k/month profit with a team of 2 or fewer people.
Exclude content creation, dropshipping, and agencies.
Explain the leverage mechanism in each.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: What opens up as AI gets cheaper
prompts.text:
What businesses become viable in [market] specifically because LLM inference cost dropped 100x?
Exclude chatbots and content generation.
Focus on workflows that were previously too expensive to automate.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A second product for existing customers
prompts.text:
I run [business].
What are 8 'second products' I can sell to my existing customer base with near-zero acquisition cost?
Rank by how much they leverage trust I've already built versus requiring new proof.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A test that can kill the idea
prompts.text:
Here are 5 business ideas: [list].
For each, design the cheapest possible falsifiable test - a test where a negative result kills the idea, not one designed to succeed.
Include exact success/failure thresholds.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Three critics
prompts.text:
Stress-test this idea: [idea].
Answer as three separate personas: a skeptical investor, my most cynical potential customer, and a competitor who wants to crush me.
Then tell me which objection is most likely fatal.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Show the market math
prompts.text:
Estimate the real addressable market for [idea] in [region] bottom-up: number of potential buyers × realistic penetration × price.
Show your arithmetic and name the number that, if wrong, changes the conclusion.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Business openings in new initiatives
prompts.text:
Identify 8 government digitization initiatives, new regulations, or infrastructure projects in [country] announced in the last 12 months.
For each, propose a private business that rides the wave.
Answer in Uzbek.

exercises.title: Critical thinking
exercises.note: Testing plans and decisions against assumptions, risks and a strong counter-argument.

prompts.title: Separate facts from assumptions
prompts.text:
Here is my plan/belief: [text].
List every assumption it rests on, explicit and hidden.
Sort into three buckets: verified facts, plausible guesses, and pure hope.
For each 'hope', tell me what evidence would move it to 'fact'.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: The strong case against your plan
prompts.text:
Act as the smartest person who thinks my plan [plan] will fail.
You have full access to my reasoning.
Attack the plan, not strawmen of it.
Rank your attacks by expected damage.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Why did the competitor do that?
prompts.text:
My competitor/opponent did [action], which looks stupid to me.
Construct 3 explanations under which their action is actually rational given information or incentives I might not see.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: What must you know before deciding?
prompts.text:
I'm deciding between [options].
Separate this into: what I know, what I can find out cheaply before deciding, and what I can only learn by deciding.
Am I stalling on things in bucket 3 that no amount of analysis will resolve?
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: What does reversing the decision cost?
prompts.text:
For decision [X]: is it reversible or irreversible, and what does reversal actually cost in money, time, and reputation?
If it's cheaply reversible, tell me to stop analyzing and decide.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: See the failure in advance
prompts.text:
Run a pre-mortem on [plan].
It's 12 months later and the plan failed completely.
Write the internal post-mortem: what went wrong, in what order, and which early warning sign did we ignore?
Give me 3 distinct failure narratives.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Should the project go on?
prompts.text:
I've invested [time/money] into [project].
Evaluate whether to continue using only future costs and future benefits.
Every time my framing smuggles in past investment, call it out.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Check time and cost against similar projects
prompts.text:
I estimated [task] will take [time/cost].
Find the reference class: what did similar projects by similar people actually take?
Adjust my estimate to the base rate and tell me what my inside-view estimate ignored.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Find a better question
prompts.text:
The question I'm asking is: [question].
Generate 5 better questions - questions that, if answered, would make my original question irrelevant or trivial.
Answer in Uzbek.

exercises.title: Sales and negotiation
exercises.note: From the first call to pricing, objections, negotiation and the proposal.

prompts.title: The first sales call
prompts.text:
I'm meeting [prospect: company, role, industry] for a first call about [my offer].
Generate 12 discovery questions ordered so each answer earns the right to ask the next.
Mark which 3 questions reveal budget without asking about budget.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Let the client name the cost of the problem
prompts.text:
Write 5 questions that surface the cost of the prospect's current process without me stating it.
The goal: they say the painful number out loud, in their own words, before I ever mention my price.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: The post-call debrief
prompts.text:
Convert my last call notes [paste notes] into: confirmed pains, stated metrics, unspoken risks I noticed, decision process as described, and the 3 things I failed to ask that I must ask next call.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Explain the price through value
prompts.text:
I charge [price] for [offer].
Build the value math: quantify the client's current cost of the problem in their numbers, show my price as a ratio of value delivered, and give me the 3-sentence version I say out loud when I state the price.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A three-tier offer
prompts.text:
Design a 3-tier offer for [service]: a stripped anchor-low tier I don't want them to buy, the target tier, and a premium tier that makes the target look reasonable.
Price all three and explain the psychological function of each.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Preparing for objections
prompts.text:
List the 10 most likely objections to [my offer] for [prospect type].
For each, write: the fear underneath the objection, the reframe, one proof point, and the check-question that confirms the objection is resolved.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Unpacking “too expensive”
prompts.text:
'It's too expensive.' Give me 6 distinct responses depending on what it actually means: no budget, no perceived value, comparing to wrong alternative, negotiating ritual, wrong buyer, or genuine mismatch.
Include the diagnostic question that identifies which one I'm facing.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: “Send a proposal, we’ll think about it”
prompts.text:
'Send me a proposal and we'll think about it.' Give me 4 responses that convert this into either a concrete next step with a date or an honest no - I want to kill the maybe.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Reopening a proposal that went quiet
prompts.text:
The prospect went silent after the proposal.
Write a 3-message revival sequence over 2 weeks: message 1 adds new value, message 2 introduces a relevant proof point, message 3 is the direct 'closing the file' breakup.
No 'just checking in' anywhere.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A sales roleplay with scoring
prompts.text:
Roleplay as [prospect persona: skeptical CFO / burned-before founder / procurement officer].
I'll pitch [offer] and you object realistically, escalating pressure each round.
After each of my responses, break character and score me on: did I acknowledge, did I diagnose, did I advance.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A negotiation prep sheet
prompts.text:
Prepare my negotiation sheet for [deal]: my target, my walk-away, my best alternative if this dies, their likely alternatives, the full list of tradeable variables beyond price (scope, timeline, payment terms, IP, exclusivity, case study rights), and my opening position with rationale.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: The structure of a proposal
prompts.text:
Write my proposal structure for [deal] so the proposal closes itself: their words about their problem first, cost of inaction with their numbers, my approach as the bridge, proof, then investment - with the decision reduced to one signature-ready choice.
Answer in Uzbek.

exercises.title: Advertising and creative
exercises.note: Angles, customer personas, a video script and ad diagnosis.

prompts.title: Ten angles for an ad
prompts.text:
Product: [product].
Audience: [audience].
Generate 10 ad angles ranked by likely CTR: pain-led, status-led, curiosity-led, social-proof-led, contrarian, before/after, us-vs-old-way, founder story, objection-preemption, urgency.
For each angle: hook line, core promise, and the emotion it targets.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Five customer personas
prompts.text:
Take my product [product] and write 5 distinct customer avatars.
For each avatar: the moment they'd stop scrolling, the words they use for their problem (their words, marketing-speak forbidden), and the visual world they trust (colors, settings, faces, textures).
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: The ad message and its proof
prompts.text:
Write the messaging hierarchy for [product]: the one-line claim, three supporting proofs, and the objection each proof neutralizes.
Every ad asset we generate must map to one node in this tree - output the tree as structured JSON I can feed into a generation pipeline.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Where is the ad failing?
prompts.text:
My ad account data says: [paste metrics per creative].
Diagnose the funnel: is the problem thumb-stop (hook), hold (body), click (CTA), or post-click (landing mismatch)?
Prescribe which creative element to regenerate and which to keep frozen.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: 20 short ad hooks
prompts.text:
Generate 20 hooks for [product] in [language], max 8 words each, split evenly: question hooks, number hooks, negative/warning hooks, and 'you' hooks.
Rank by predicted scroll-stop for [platform + audience].
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A 15-second video script
prompts.text:
Design a 3-scene, 15-second ad script for [product] where each scene is one generated clip: Scene 1 problem visualization (5s), Scene 2 product moment (5s), Scene 3 result + CTA space (5s).
Write the generation prompt for each scene plus the continuity notes between them.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Answering a competitor’s ad
prompts.text:
Build a competitor-response system: input = screenshot/description of a new competitor ad → LLM extracts their angle and offer → generates 3 counter-ad concepts → drafts generation prompts.
Write the extraction prompt and the counter-positioning prompt.
Answer in Uzbek.

exercises.title: Learning
exercises.note: Ways to pick up a new skill quickly and deeply.

prompts.title: The unwritten rules practitioners know
prompts.text:
For [field], list the 10 concepts that practitioners consider obvious but never explain to beginners - the tacit knowledge that separates people who've done it from people who've read about it.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A learning plan that starts from the result
prompts.text:
I have [X hours/week] for [Y weeks] to learn [skill] well enough to [specific outcome].
Design the curriculum backwards from the outcome: what must I be able to DO at week Y, and what does each week build toward that?
Every week ends with a produced artifact, no week ends with only 'understanding'.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Learning through questions
prompts.text:
Teach me [concept] Socratically: ask me questions one at a time, never lecture.
Start from what I already know [describe], and let me construct the concept through my own answers.
Correct me only when I'm confidently wrong.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Test what you know with hard questions
prompts.text:
I believe I understand [topic].
Generate the 5 questions a hostile examiner would ask to expose the difference between my familiarity and actual understanding.
Ask them one at a time and grade harshly.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Rehearse the situation beforehand
prompts.text:
I want to practice [skill] against you.
Simulate [scenario: client meeting / code review / debate / language conversation] at difficulty 6/10.
Stay in character; after we finish, break character and give me: 3 specific moments I handled badly, what the strong move was, and the one pattern to fix before next session.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: 30 minutes with an expert
prompts.text:
I have 30 minutes with an expert in [field].
Draft my question list: no questions Google answers, no 'what's your advice for beginners'.
I want their decision heuristics, their war stories about being wrong, and what they'd never do again. 10 questions, ordered.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Lessons from an experience
prompts.text:
Turn my recent experience into learning: here's what happened [describe project/event].
Run an after-action review with me - ask one question at a time: what was the plan, what actually happened, why the gap, what do I keep, what do I change.
Then extract 3 transferable principles, stated as if-then rules.
Answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: A one-page cheat sheet
prompts.text:
Compress everything essential about [topic] onto one page I could rebuild the full understanding from: the core principle, the 5 key distinctions, the 3 procedures, and the failure modes.
This page is my retrieval scaffold - make every word earn its place.
Answer in Uzbek.

praktikum.title: Hermes: your personal AI agent.
praktikum.lead: A personal AI agent on your own server: Hermes, a Telegram bot, memory and a morning briefing. Nine cards and a bonus.
rules: Work through the cards in order — each builds on the one before.
Copy the whole prompt with the “Nusxalash” button and send it where its heading says.
Fill in the parts in square brackets yourself.
Never type a key, token or password into a chat.
praktikum.exercisesNote: Start with the first card. Working on a laptop? Look for “The laptop route” on each card.
praktikum.promptsNote: Copy it and send it where the heading says.

exercises.title: Install
exercises.note: Result: Claude shows the Hermes version. Takes 5–10 minutes.

prompts.title: Send to Claude Code
prompts.text:
SERVER.md faylimni oʻqi va "ssh vps" orqali serverimga ulan.
Serverga Hermes Agent oʻrnat.
Rasmiy buyruq: `curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | bash -s -- --skip-browser --skip-computer-use`
Oʻrnatish 5-10 daqiqa oladi: kutib tur, yarim yoʻlda toʻxtatma.
Butun dars uchun ikki qoida, ularni SERVER.md ga ham yoz:
- hermes buyrugʻini doim toʻliq yoʻl bilan chaqir: `~/.local/bin/hermes`
- sudo ishlatma: hamma narsa mening oddiy foydalanuvchim nomidan ishga tushsin.
Oxirida vaqt mintaqasini Toshkentga oʻrnat (`hermes config set timezone Asia/Tashkent`) va `hermes --version` natijasini menga koʻrsat.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: The line "setup skipped (no terminal)" is normal. Claude does the setup in the cards that follow.

notes.title: The laptop route
notes.text: Instead of "ssh vps" in the prompt, tell Claude Code: "install everything on this computer, don't connect to a server"; you don't need SERVER.md. On Windows, Claude picks the PowerShell installer itself. Later, card 9 moves the agent to a VPS without losing anything.

exercises.title: The brain
exercises.note: Result: the agent gives its first answer in Uzbek.

prompts.title: Send to Claude Code
prompts.text:
Hermes OpenRouter orqali ishlasin.
OpenRouter kalitimni chatga yozishimni soʻrama.
Menga alohida terminalda oʻzim ishga tushiradigan bitta buyruq ber: u serverga ulanadi, kalitni ekranda koʻrsatmasdan soʻraydi va uni `~/.hermes/.env` fayliga `OPENROUTER_API_KEY=...` qatori sifatida qoʻshadi.
Men "tayyor" desam:
1. Provayder: openrouter. Model: `google/gemini-3.8-flash`.
2. `~/.hermes/config.yaml` ichida shu model uchun OpenRouter provayder tartibini oʻrnat: avval google-ai-studio, keyin google-vertex (provider_routing ning models boʻlimi).
3. Sinov: `hermes chat -q "Salom! Bir gapda: sen kimsan?"` va javobni menga koʻrsat.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: The key: create a new key at openrouter.ai/keys and give it a monthly limit (say $5). The whole lesson costs about $0.10.

exercises.title: Dashboard and gateway
exercises.note: Result: http://localhost:9119 opens in your browser, and the bottom left reads "Gateway Status: Running".

prompts.title: Send to Claude Code
prompts.text:
Serverda ikkita doimiy xizmatni sozla.
Ikkalasi ham systemd user service boʻlsin, sudoʼsiz, va server qayta yuklanganidan keyin oʻzi ishga tushsin (`loginctl enable-linger`):
1. Gateway: `hermes gateway install`
2. Dashboard: `hermes dashboard --no-open --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9119`. Yangi port ochma, firewallʼga tegma.
Keyin kompyuterimdagi `~/.ssh/config` fayliga "hermes-panel" nomli yangi yozuv qoʻsh: "vps" bilan bir xil server, foydalanuvchi va kalit, plyus `LocalForward 9119 127.0.0.1:9119`.
Menga alohida terminalda qaysi buyruqni ishga tushirishni va brauzerda qaysi manzilni ochishni ayt.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: Keep the tunnel terminal open until the end of the lesson. If you close it, only the dashboard goes away. The agent keeps running on the server.

notes.title: The laptop route
notes.text: No tunnel needed: the dashboard opens straight at `http://localhost:9119`. Start it in an ordinary terminal with `hermes dashboard` and leave the window open. `hermes gateway install` picks the right autostart for your system (launchd on a Mac, a scheduled task on Windows). The agent only runs while the laptop is on and awake.

exercises.title: Telegram
exercises.note: Result: the bot on your phone answers "Salom".

notes.title: In the dashboard (nothing to copy)
notes.text:
1. In the dashboard: CHANNELS, then Telegram, then CREATE WITH QR.
2. Scan the QR code with your phone. @NousHostedHermesBot opens: tap "Start", then "Create bot".
3. In the same chat, tap "Connect this bot". The message may arrive twice: tap either one. Without this step the dashboard stays at "waiting".
4. The dashboard shows "Ready", with your ID under ALLOWED USERS. Click SAVE AND RESTART.
5. Send your new bot "Salom".

notes.title: If the QR doesn't work
notes.text: Create a bot in @BotFather with `/newbot`, and get your ID from @userinfobot. In the dashboard, enter the token and the ID under MANUAL SETUP and save. The token goes into the dashboard only, never into a chat.

exercises.title: The interview
exercises.note: Result: the bot introduces itself by name and can describe your business. 25–30 minutes.

prompts.title: Send to Claude Code
prompts.text:
Sen tajribali biznes-konsultantsan.
Maqsad: mening shaxsiy AI agentim uchun ikkita fayl tayyorlash.
Menga savollarni BITTADAN ber va javobimni kut.
Menga oson boʻlishi uchun har bir savolga 2-3 ta misol javob qoʻsh.
Agar javobim qisqa yoki noaniq boʻlsa, bitta aniqlashtiruvchi savol ber.
Jami 12 tadan koʻp boʻlmagan savol, uchta blokda:
- A. Men: ismim, rolim, kunim qanday oʻtadi, qanday muloqot qilishni yoqtiraman, qaysi tilda.
- B. Biznesim: nima sotamiz, mijozlarimiz kim, jamoa, asosiy raqamlar, raqobatchilar, hozirgi 3 ta eng katta ogʻriq.
- C. Agentim: uning ismi, xarakteri, har kuni men uchun nima qilishi kerak, nima qilmasligi kerak.
Intervyu tugagach, avval ikkala faylni menga koʻrsat:
1. SOUL.md: agentning ismi, xarakteri, ohangi, tili va chegaralari. Biznes faktlarisiz. Salomlashishga qisqa javob bersin. 2 500 belgidan oshmasin.
2. AGENTS.md: biznesim haqidagi faktlar va agentning ish qoidalari.
Men "Tasdiqlayman" desam:
- SOUL.md ni serverdagi `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` manziliga joyla (eskisini SOUL.md.bak qilib saqla);
- `~/biznes` papkasini yarat va AGENTS.md ni u yerga joyla;
- uni Hermesʼning ishchi papkasi qil: toʻliq yoʻl bilan `hermes config set terminal.cwd`;
- oxirida gatewayʼni qayta ishga tushir.

notes.title: Check
notes.text: Send `/new` in Telegram, then write: "Who are you and what do you know about my business?". The bot should answer with the name from SOUL.md and list the facts about your business.

exercises.title: Remember me
exercises.note: Result: facts about you appear in USER.md.

prompts.title: Send to Claude Code
prompts.text:
Intervyudagi javoblarim asosida Telegram botimga yuboradigan bitta xabar tayyorla.
Xabar "Buni xotirangga saqla:" bilan boshlansin, 600 belgidan oshmasin va faqat men haqimdagi eng muhim faktlarni oʻz ichiga olsin: ism, rol, muloqot uslubi, ish soatlari.
Men uni botga yuboraman va senga "yubordim" deyman.
Keyin serverdagi `~/.hermes/memories/USER.md` faylini oʻqi va faktlar haqiqatan ham saqlanganini tekshir.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: The agent only saves what you ask it to. If a fact went missing, message the bot separately: "Save this to memory: ...".

exercises.title: Morning briefing
exercises.note: Result: a test briefing arrives, and the job shows on the dashboard's CRON page.

prompts.title: Write this to the bot in Telegram

notes.title: Note
notes.text: Check the numbers. The agent searches the web and shows its sources, but it can be wrong too. Open the source before any decision that matters.

exercises.title: Final test
exercises.note: Result: the bot answers again after the server reboots.

prompts.title: Yourself, in a separate terminal
prompts.text: Serverni qayta yuklang: `ssh -t vps sudo reboot`. Parolni oʻzingiz kiritasiz. 2 daqiqa kuting.

prompts.title: Then send to Claude Code
prompts.text:
Mening "vps" serverim qayta yuklandi.
Hermes gateway va dashboard xizmatlari oʻz-oʻzidan ishga tushganini tekshir va menga ularning holatini koʻrsat.

notes.title: The final proof
notes.text: Message your bot from your phone and get an answer. Reopen the tunnel (`ssh -N hermes-panel`) and check that the dashboard opens again.

notes.title: The laptop route
notes.text: Instead of rebooting a server, close the laptop lid for a minute, then open it and message the bot. While the laptop sleeps the bot is silent, and a briefing due in that time is skipped or arrives late: the best proof of why the agent belongs on a VPS.

exercises.title: Move to a VPS
exercises.note: Result: the same bot answers with its old name, memory and morning briefing, now even with the laptop closed. About 15 minutes.

prompts.title: Send to Claude Code
prompts.text:
Hermes agentimni shu kompyuterdan yangi VPS serverimga hech narsa yoʻqotmasdan koʻchirmoqchiman.
SERVER.md faylimni oʻqi: server "ssh vps" nomi bilan ulangan.
1. Kompyuterimda: `hermes backup -o ~/hermes-kochirish.zip` bilan toʻliq zaxira nusxa ol va `~/biznes` papkamni alohida arxivga joyla.
2. Serverga Hermes oʻrnat (1-kartadagi rasmiy buyruq, ikki qoida bilan: toʻliq yoʻl `~/.local/bin/hermes`, sudoʼsiz).
3. Ikkala arxivni serverga koʻchir, `hermes import ~/hermes-kochirish.zip --force` bilan tikla va `~/biznes` ni uy papkamga och.
4. Serverdagi `~/.hermes/config.yaml` ichida kompyuterimga tegishli har bir yoʻlni server yoʻliga almashtir (masalan `terminal.cwd`, `tts.gemini.persona_prompt_file`), keyin `hermes doctor` ni ishga tushir.
5. Muhim: avval kompyuterimdagi gatewayʼni toʻxtat va uning avtoishga tushishini oʻchir. Bitta Telegram bot bir vaqtda faqat bitta joyda ishlay oladi.
6. Keyin serverda gateway va boshqaruv panelini 3-kartadagidek doimiy xizmat qil va ularning holatini koʻrsat.
7. Zaxira zip faylini ikkala mashinada ham oʻchir: unda kalitlarim bor.
Oxirida men botga yozaman, sen esa serverdagi gateway logida xabar kelganini tekshirasan.

notes.title: Note
notes.text: The backup holds everything: the persona, memory, settings, keys, skills, scheduled jobs and chat history. Only the `~/biznes` folder sits outside it, so it moves as a second archive. Never send the backup zip to a chat or by email: it holds your keys.

exercises.title: Voice agent
exercises.note: Result: you send the bot a voice message in Uzbek; it shows what it heard and answers with a voice message.

prompts.title: Send to Claude Code
prompts.text:
Hermes agentim mening oʻzbekcha ovozli xabarlarimni tushunishini va ovoz bilan javob berishini xohlayman, ikkalasi ham Google Gemini orqali.
Google AI Studio kalitimni chatga yozishimni soʻrama.
Menga alohida terminalda oʻzim ishga tushiradigan bitta buyruq ber: u kalitni ekranda koʻrsatmasdan soʻraydi va serverdagi `~/.hermes/.env` fayliga `GEMINI_API_KEY=...` qatori qilib qoʻshadi.
Men "tayyor" desam:
1. Ovozli javoblar: `hermes config set tts.provider gemini`, `tts.gemini.model` = `gemini-3.8-flash-tts`, `tts.gemini.voice` = `Kore` va `tts.gemini.base_url` = `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta` (bu qator Hermes xatosini aylanib oʻtish uchun kerak, uni saqlab qol).
2. Qisqa ovoz yoʻriqnomasi faylini yoz: `~/.hermes/voice-uz.md` ("native Uzbek speaker from Tashkent, calm and warm, read numbers as Uzbek words") va `tts.gemini.persona_prompt_file` ga uning toʻliq yoʻlini oʻrnat.
3. Ovozni tushunish: kichik Python skript yoz: `~/.hermes/bin/gemini-stt.py` (faqat standart kutubxona). U audio fayl yoʻli va chiqish matn fayli yoʻlini oladi, audioni Gemini API modeli `gemini-3.8-flash` ga inline audio sifatida yuboradi, prompt esa: "transcribe verbatim; Uzbek in Latin script, Russian words in Cyrillic, English words in Latin; output only the transcript", `GEMINI_API_KEY` ni muhit oʻzgaruvchisidan yoki `~/.hermes/.env` dan oʻqiydi va transkriptni chiqish fayliga yozadi. Avval uni biror audio faylda sinab koʻr.
4. `~/.hermes/config.yaml` faylida, `stt:` boʻlimi ichida `provider: gemini`, `language: uz` qilib oʻrnat va buyruq provayderini qoʻsh: `providers` → `gemini` → `type: command`, `command: "python3 <full path>/gemini-stt.py {input_path} {output_path}"`, `env_passthrough: [GEMINI_API_KEY]`, `timeout: 120`. Faylni toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri tahrirla: `hermes config set` bu blokni yoza olmaydi.
5. Gatewayʼni qayta ishga tushir.

Keyin Telegramʼda `/voice on` yubor va ovozli xabar yozib joʻnat.

notes.title: Notes
notes.text:
- `/voice on`: a voice reply only when you send a voice message. `/voice tts`: a voice reply to every message. `/voice off`: text only.
- The bot shows the transcript first ("🎙️ ..."), so you can see what it heard.
